risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight rate-sensitive defensives (WES.AX, CSL.AX); underweight rate-sensitive REITs and construction

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor AUD/USD and reduce foreign-currency-denominated risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with banks providing support. Fourth RBA hike and 10% house price fall forecasts create headwinds for property/construction. Gold and gas names outperform. Oil firm on OPEC+ discipline. Volatility elevated on geopolitical and housing risks.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural iron ore oversupply and housing correction cap materials and REIT upside. Energy transition cost overhang and EV adoption reshape consumer/auto sectors. AI/tech global momentum supports sentiment but limited ASX direct exposure. Gold remains a strategic hedge. RBA policy normalisation to support bank earnings but pressure growth equities.
